calculation.description: Ranks assets by ten-day downside-volatility-normalized reversal and increases reversal intensity when average cross-asset 20-day volatility is above its trailing 120-day median. All inputs are lagged completed closes.

validation.regime_notes: 2025-2027 IC +0.042332 (365 dates); 2028-2029 IC -0.006583 (521 dates); 2030-2032-04-14 IC +0.064898 (587 dates). No aligned 2020-2024 observations in retrieved sample. Small cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
validation.provenance: Computed from synthetic 15-asset universe with completed daily closes only; forward ten-day return used solely for validation. Pairwise artifact correlation computed against available signal artifacts.
